latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of "brand-guidelines-pro": applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography.
- Supports smart font assignment (Poppins for headings, Lora for body; falls back to Arial/Georgia).
- Provides detailed guidelines for brand colors and visual hierarchy.
- Automatically handles accent and background colors for shapes and text.
- Requires no extra font installation if Poppins/Lora are already on your system.
